title: Distributed Systems: Replication, Failures, and Raft Consensus
subject: Distributed Systems
description: Reason about partial failure and trace a client command through leader election, replicated logs, majority commitment, and recovery.
outcomes: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to trace a client command through a three-node Raft cluster and identify the exact sequence of log replication and commit steps.
By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to explain how majority quorums and term-based voting prevent conflicting committed histories during network partitions.
By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to design a client retry strategy that avoids duplicate operations while maintaining system availability during partial failures.
